desc: Parse the given HTML file(s) and dump the parse tree
u: htmltree - Parse the given HTML file(s) and dump the parse tree

htmltree -D3 -w file1 file2 file3

 Options:
    -D[number]  sets HTML::TreeBuilder::Debug to that figure.
    -w  turns on $tree->warn(1) for the new tree
    -h  Help message
